items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Louis Bellson, Buddy de Franco, Charlie

ctx.x: You were telling me on the last tape about a combo that was co-led by Louis Bellson and Charlie Shavers and that your first date was in Rock Island, Illinois. Who was in the group?
Louis Bellson, Buddy de Franco, Charlie

Shavers, Hank Jones and myself. Hank never played a note. And Hank -- I mean, Charlie and Buddy de Franco and Louis Bellson were on vacation from Tommy's band at the time. So this was a filler for them, you know, playing his home town and everything, you know. Local boy returns home, you know.
